notes.title: Removal from Steam
notes.content: [h1][b]This game will soon be permanently removed from Steam. Those who have purchased it will retain it in their library.[/b][/h1][p][/p]

notes.title: Z9K Games has signed with Slitherine
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have a special news for you.

Developer Studio [b]Z9K Games[/b] has signed with [b]Slitherine[/b] and we are happy to announce that thanks to this partnership [b]Panzer Doctrine[/b] and [b]Land Doctrine[/b] are now part of the Slitherine Catalog.

We are thrilled for this incredible collaboration which fruits, we are sure, will be super interesting for the strategy gaming community.

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.06 has been released!
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

- Tank design do not start if player has already designed 10 tanks
- More than 3 enemy battalions on a single node
- Enemy battalion stops, and can not move, can not interact
- Tactic panel on battle window has a missing word
- Enemy retreat to the wrong direction
- Player battalion speed calculation can be false after upgrade tank

notes.title: Update v1.05 released
notes.content:
Bugs fixed:

- Speed decrease to zero after adding new company or upgrade
- AI attack during ceasefire
- AI generates too many enemy units
- Entrenchment has no upper limit (now it is 100)

Changes:

- Now it is possible to delete a tank design, but player must have at least one design. It is also delete the tanks from the inventory, production lines and no longer possible to produce it.
- Faster navigation on the map
- Added WASD keys to navigate on map
